## Description

Create >=5 YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/ covering agentic UI patterns (SC-4 sub-domain i). Update _index.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] >=5 YAML files created in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/ (or agentic subdirectory) with domain: patterns
- [ ] Files cover: multi-level-transparency.yaml, human-in-the-loop-interaction.yaml, persistent-intervention-controls.yaml, plain-language-agentic-pairs.yaml, agentic-status-indicators.yaml
- [ ] Each file has required fields: rule_id (unique), prior_art, precedence, domain: patterns, tags
- [ ] Each file includes explicit do/dont pair examples in content
- [ ] Summary and Detail tiers populated; Implementation tier is stretch goal
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all new files
- [ ] ref-query.py returns >=1 result for 'human in the loop' query in patterns domain
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new entries
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_patterns_agentic.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: >=5 entries covering agentic patterns
- DD2: do/dont pairs included
- DD3: Schema-valid entries
- DD4: ref-query returns results for agentic query
- DD5: Summary + Detail tiers populated

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/multi-level-transparency.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/human-in-the-loop-interaction.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/persistent-intervention-controls.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/plain-language-agentic-pairs.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/agentic-status-indicators.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml [UPDATE]
